commerce-api.name: catalog:write
commerce-api.description: Publish a product to the catalogue (§11.4).

commerce-api.name: inventory:admin
commerce-api.description: Administer inventory through the gateway's inventory-admin route (§10.2): set a product's on-hand stock and inspect, release or reinstate a reservation. Granted to demo locally because stock exists only through this API (§14.1).

commerce-api.name: orders:write
commerce-api.description: Place an order (§11.4). Required by POST /v1/orders and granted to demo, so the inner loop the compose README documents actually works.

commerce-api.name: orders:cancel
commerce-api.description: Cancel one's own order (§11.4). Required by POST /v1/orders/{id}/cancel, granted to demo. Separate from orders:write: a caller holding only write gets 403.

commerce-api.name: orders:admin
commerce-api.description: Act on an order the caller does not own (§11.4). A claim CancelOrderHandler reads, never an endpoint policy. Grantable and granted to nobody: without the role the handler's admin branch is unreachable.

clients.name: Commerce API
clients.description: The platform's APIs. Holds the permission vocabulary (§11.4) and is the audience every service validates (§11.3).

clients.name: Web app (browser)
clients.description: The SPA. Authorization code + PKCE (§11.2); direct access grants so a developer can obtain a token with curl.

clients.name: Web BFF
clients.description: The one host that calls a service synchronously (§9.7), and therefore the only one holding client credentials (§11.5). Service accounts only: no browser flow, and nothing can obtain a token as a person through it.

clientScopes.name: commerce-api
clientScopes.description: Access to the commerce APIs: sets the audience and the permission claim.

clientScopes.name: basic
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add all basic claims to the token

clientScopes.name: web-origins
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add allowed web origins to the access token

clientScopes.name: acr
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add acr (authentication context class reference) to the token

clientScopes.name: organization
clientScopes.description: Additional claims about the organization a subject belongs to

clientScopes.name: roles
clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token
